---
title: "Reusable modules"
---

The functions live in `components/cards.lmd`, a Lua file that may hold
markdown fragments. `require` loads it relative to this document, so any
cell on the page can use it:

```{lmd}
local cards = require("components/cards")
return cards.card("Hello", {=[ from a *module* ]=})
```

The module ran once; a second `require` returns the same table. Its
functions take ordinary Lua values, so a list of records becomes a deck
of cards:

```{lmd}
local cards = require("components/cards")
return cards.deck(pandoc.List({
  { title = "One", body = "first" },
  { title = "Two", body = "second" },
}))
```
